reviews.outcome: No defect found in these selected register definitions and flowcharts. Both diagrams test the current counter before incrementing on the loop-back edge; flattened text extraction alone obscures this. The register-to-tape argument is explicitly a sketch with details omitted. The corpus will supply its own finite marked-track native-machine table, phase invariants and output cleanup, and its own clear/copy/frame/return compiler proofs, rather than credit the omitted details as checked source proofs. Source I/O uses input registers1..n and output0; the actual tape bridge fixes its own distinguished input/output indices explicitly.
